job.title: Vice President - Technology Recruitment
job.description:
The Company

Our client is an award-winning, multi-million-pound staffing firm specialised in providing Digital and Technology talent to a diverse range of customers across five countries. The organisation is renowned for delivering world class customer service to its clients and candidates. They have a global presence with offices within the UK, Europe, and the US

They are a values-led business focused on employee engagement and career development to enable outstanding performance throughout each of its brands. To back this up they have won many awards and are ranked as one of the best recruitment agencies to work for

The Role

They are looking for a talented professional to open a new office for them in the Boston area USA . You will be serving as a trusted partners to leading brands, You will grow and develop a team of expert Consultants and recruitment professionals within the Technology and digital marketplace and leverage the great name and reputation of this first class brand  As a True VP / MD , you will take full charge of the existing brand offering a range of staffing services including Contracts and Permanent recruitment (both Retained and Contingency) as well as their embedded Talent-as-a-Service (‘TaaS’) model. You will report directly to the Head of US and Group CEO bearing full autonomy for the growth and development of the Boston office

 

Core Responsibilities & Skills

  • Drive performance and results, channelled through a management structure
  • Develop long term plans, sets goals, determines priorities, and identifies risks and opportunities
  • Analyse future recruitment trends derived to ensure best in class products and service
  • P&L management including accurate forecasting of Revenue, NFI & EBIDTA projection
  • Build relationships internally and externally including senior relationship management with key clients
  • Acts as a leader and mentor, not only to the team members but also to the wider business

The Person

Ideally, the successful individual will have a strong background and wealth of experience in the Technology staffing sector. You will have a successful track record of ‘360’ recruitment and be someone who can demonstrate successfully scaling a Contract and Permanent recruitment business. You will have the gravitas to present at board level and will be a great leader of people, You will be energetic, highly motivated, and results-driven with a proven record of success.

Package : Basic $140-175k OTE $300-400k  
Plus executive benefits including Equity package

job.title: Lead Data Architect
job.description:
Los Angeles USD $ 150-200k +benefits

Our client a leading global Technology consulting firm requires an experienced Data Architect to compliment there existing projects . 
They have a first class reputation within their field and are a go to employer of choice you will be working on market leading projects and this role is a game changer for your career   

You will need :
  • Experience in client-facing projects in a global consulting setting
  • Working on projects within AWS and/or Azure cloud.
  • Hands on with legacy big data technologies 
  • Hands on with cloud data management technologies such as AWS Redshift and Snowflake
  • Designing cloud solutions incorporating Information Security principles and best practices to ensure designs are in accordance with regulatory data security and data governance principles

  • Full lifecycle solution development and deployment best practices for the cloud

Technical Abilities:

  • Experience in migration from on-premises data warehouse (SQL Server, Teradata) to cloud solutions (AWS Redshift, Snowflake (preferred))
  • Experience with AWS stack, particularly around Compute (EC2, EMR), ETL, Orchestration and Scheduling (AWS Glue, AWS Lambda)
  • Strong understanding of data governance principles including, but not limited to Master Data Management, Data Lineage and Data Security
  • Strong experience working with a variety of ETL/ELT tools
  • Strong development background with experience in at least two scripting, object oriented or functional programming language, etc. SQL, Python, Java, Scala, C#, R
  • Data Warehousing experience, building operational ETL/ELT data pipelines across a number of sources, and constructing relational and dimensional data models
  • Strong Solutions architecture experience
